newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-STANGER JOINS LIONS AS STANDBY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-STANGER JOINS LIONS AS STANDBY.

text.p: Wing Tony Stanger, on tour with Scotland in South Africa, has been drafted into the British Lions party as cover for the injured Ieuan Evans and Will Greenwood.
Before the Lions left Durban on Sunday for the final two matches of their 13-fixture tour, manager Fran Cotton said Stanger had joined the squad in a standby capacity.
"Dependent on what happens in our next match on Tuesday, he'll probably then rejoin the Scotland tour afterwards," Cotton said.
Cotton said both hooker Keith Wood and wing Alan Tait were suffering from groin strains after the Durban test.
"Our team doctor James Robson will be monitoring them over the next couple of days."
